en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of a small historic town set in a hilly rural landscape. Dominating the left side is a large church with a tall tower and spire, surrounded by traditional European houses with steep roofs. On the right side stands a castle-like complex with towers rising above dense trees. Fields and forests stretch into the distant hills. Centered below the image is the printed caption "Zschopau."
